# Native function and ownership certificate

## One changed window

The old helper464 schedule has `Q(0,B,1)`, an aligned ADD from SOURCE0 at
`B=frame2`, then `Q(B,C,3)` with `C=frame507`. SOURCE0 later has its own
`Q(B,C,3)`. Between the old ADD and that SOURCE move there is no SOURCE0
VALUE write. Its later write is outside the window. The old local capture
slot658 and its immutable-source ticket are retained unchanged.

Allocate independent owned slot659, initialize its entire payload to zero,
and copy SOURCE0 at B by one paid pointwise XOR. Move SOURCE0 B to C at
the old ADD location. The two remaining B-frame reads of SOURCE0 use the
shadow. At the former helper move, move helper464 directly 0 to C (rank4)
and then add the current SOURCE0 at C. The former later SOURCE move is
deleted; the shadow receives a paid whole-payload CLEAR after its last
use. These are exact common-FRAME operations. For arbitrary functions,

    old: h_C = D_(C-B)(D_B h_0 + D_B x_0)
             = D_C h_0 + D_C x_0
    new: h_C = D_C h_0 + D_C x_0.

Here nested orthogonal projectors satisfy the actual paired ADDRESS
identity D_(C-B)D_B=D_C. A FRAME identifier is not a query rank. All
projectors, nested ranks and the fresh rank4 matcher S Q4 S^-1 are checked
over Q from the pinned frame basis. The window replaces ranks [1,3,3]
with [3,4]. It removes one occurrence while preserving rank mass 7.

No rank8 LOCAL call is introduced, and no ticket for a different SOURCE or
version is inherited. Field659 is a private workspace, not an extra DATA
job. It remains live alongside slot658, so the new peak is two complete
arrays instead of one.

## Inverse and rawdual

The inverse is independently correct; it is not obtained by reversing a
noninvertible CLEAR. At the old inverse SOURCE move, a shadow of SOURCE0
at C is acquired. The SOURCE move back to B stays in its old position.
At the old helper ADD the helper at C is XORed with that C shadow and
then moved directly C to 0 by the same rank4 involution. All owned payload
is explicitly cleared. Both decoded compositions are the identity on all
658 originals. The entry/exit coframes are interchanged exactly.

The rawdual is the physical FUNCTION transpose of this true inverse.
Primitive ADD transposes by exchanging source and destination; SOURCE
QUERY transposes to its literal inverse ADDRESS permutation of the same
proper rank. An owned COPY is expanded into its physical assignment and
query before transposition. The zero map CLEAR is self-transpose; this
does not invert CLEAR. The reverse-mode programme begins with whole
owned zero and uses paid CLEAR plus zero-only reheaders. It has 22 paid
CLEAR operations and ten zero reheaders, the same query profile, and a
fresh 30-bit majorant. ADDRESS inverse-transpose is a different operation
and is not used here. The original argument arrays are never erased.

Every replay checks all 658 independent F2 columns, exact same-FRAME ADDs,
SOURCE ownership and version leases, proper nested QUERYs, and complete
owned return. Finite q=101 and q=101^2 all-symbol sparse controls exercise
the full 16-coordinate paired HEAD/TAIL operator. Arbitrary-function
correctness comes from the exact FRAME induction and rational projector
identities, not from extrapolating the finite controls.

## Actual global caller

The pinned p16 controller has 18 thick local calls and 15 thin readout
stages. Each thick call uses its prescribed SOURCE and TARGET banks and
436 fresh arbitrary helper functions; inverse calls use the true inverse
and prescribed bank assignment. The replaced local operator has exactly
the same original entry/exit law. SOURCE/Pi, TARGET/Ki and the four partial
helper end frames are unchanged.

For each port the central Pi and the 17 fresh, disjoint seven-dimensional
stage blocks commute. The global checker independently evaluates the
32-bank coefficient laws as sets of (initial bank, orthogonal phase), and
obtains the prescribed diagonal monomial for every bank. It separately
checks all 11,400 decoded independent RAW columns, original helper
identity, actual coframes, leases and owner histories. This is a finite
exact function proof on the inherited full ROW, not a character-only
comparison. Different ports are not assigned a common free Pi.

The local port chart is the literal rational involution rho on 8+7 axes;
all 111 charts are reconstructed from the actual SOURCE roots. Internal
entry/return routes number 7,548. Whole-job canonical matching is a
separate paid wrapper: 7,104 MAIN routes and 144 partial-helper routes,
7,248 in all. MAIN matcher recipes cover every original SOURCE-line plus
selected-stage target, and the three distinct partial rank4 geometries
have explicit rational matchers. Inherited whole-fiber right-ROW routing
is charged; no dense ADDRESS map is declared free. Identity matcher cases
may be charged by the same conservative bound.

Each emitted SOURCE descriptor records the event-prefix hash, current
owner epoch/version, actual geometry and current RAW bitmap hash. A bitmap
hash is offline control metadata, not a runtime oracle or an assertion
that a physical function is merely a scalar row. The complete literal
prefix plus the current owner defines the actual function. Compound COPY
descriptors explicitly bind their assignment-before-query step. All
57,321 descriptors are replayed independently.

## DOMAIN, ROW, stock and charges

The operator acts on complete arrays with the inherited common GLOBAL
domain, valid low unit types, ordered HEAD fields and paired TAIL in
C_(N f) order. Spectators and whole ROW coordinates are carried along.
For column width f each fixed local rational geometry tensors I_f; the
ordered lowerers, field scans, low-type/high-carry fallback, and whole
fiber row transformations are the pinned finite-precompilation/stream
contracts. Their positive finite constants must be regenerated for this
programme. A current owned SUM is a legitimate correlated actual child
input after normalization; arbitrary-input correctness of a child does
not require independence from other parent arrays. This supplies no
additional parent DATA credit. Child-owned regions remain separate from
exposed ancestor arrays.

The packet explicitly charges 378,039 XOR passes, 1,827 compound pointwise
COPY assignments, 18 shadow acquisitions, 1,845 owned clears, two initial
owned zero scans and two final teardown scans. Shadow copy ADDs are
already in the XOR count. Positive conservative parking is counted as
4*(11400+2) field passes for each paid child call, with restore and head
return, and no ancestor-region scan. This is a fixed finite-program
bound, not a saving. All fixed rational normalizers and all routes have
additional positive costs C_normalizer(N,q,P) and C_route(N,q,S).

Two complete owned banks are reserved for every compiled unit instance or
simultaneously live unit. A suspended recursive unit does not share its
reserve with another unit at the same depth. Owned jobs are not added to
the 11,400 productive ROW classes. The inherited stock proof with new
fixed finite constants, q and rank cutoff is a pending ordinary-certificate
obligation; no old numerical precision/H threshold is asserted.

The new global positive integer envelope is 485 bits; local forward,
inverse and rawdual envelopes are respectively 27,30,30 bits. These are
regenerated cancellation-free bounds, not integer-valued endpoint claims.
The all-in fee constant is a positive fixed expression from this new
programme. The 1e9 raw-record cap is not an all-in cap: even the deliberately
conservative parent parking count is larger. No bound is inferred by
silently reusing old numeric constants.

The scientific claim of this packet stops at native operator/lifecycle,
literal raw profile, and the existence of positive finite programme fees.
The existing three-tail/finite compiler and finite bootstrap must be
instantiated separately with the new profiles and constants. In particular,
the minimum target rank is 4 while some paid ranks are 63; an unrelated
strict r_max<k_min theorem cannot simply be substituted for that pipeline.
PR4760/PR4814 inputs remain byte unchanged.
